title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Targets Cybersecurity at the Frontier
dek: Only select security defenders get early access while Google tests safeguards.

facts.label: Top score on AI Intelligence Index
Intro price per million in/out tokens

caption:
Google just built an AI that hunts bugs for days, and you can't use it yet. 🔐

Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest frontier model so far, only two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon. It ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 59 and posts big numbers on cybersecurity benchmarks: 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, 54.8% on ExploitGym and 71.0% on CWE-bench. Google says it can find vulnerabilities, check if they're exploitable and write the fix.

For now, only a small group of cyber defenders gets access, with more trusted partners joining through the Fairwind Program. Google is rolling it out slowly while testing safeguards and joining U.S. government pre-release testing. Intro pricing matches Argon at $2 and $10 per million tokens.

We're tracking this one at AI Parabellum. Remember these are Google's own benchmarks, so independent tests will be the real verdict.
